name: institutional_flow_momentum_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY and BANKNIFTY, large directional institutional orders — FII block buys/sells, index ETF rebalancing, or algo momentum-ignition sequences — produce visible 5-second volume spikes of 4-8x the 10-minute rolling baseline. When such a spike bar is also strongly directional (bar return > 0.03%, roughly 6+ index points in 5 seconds) and closes on the correct side of the session VWAP, it signals net institutional conviction in that direction. Other quantitative participants detect the large print within 1-3 bars and layer in behind it, creating a 15-45 second follow-through window before price fully absorbs the order. Because NIFTY and BANKNIFTY are highly liquid and smooth compared to individual stocks, false volume spikes from thin-book bounces are rare, making the volume signal cleaner than on single equities.

indicators.name: vol_spike_ratio
indicators.purpose: 120 bars = 10 minutes rolling volume baseline. Original used 20 1-min bars = 20 min context; compressed to 10 min because at 5s bars we need responsiveness to intraday volume regime shifts (post-news spikes raise the baseline quickly). 20 min at 5s = 240 bars would mix opening-hour volatility into the mid-session baseline. 10 min captures the current regime without over-smoothing.

indicators.name: bar_return_pct
indicators.purpose: Measures directional price impact within the single 5-second spike bar. Threshold 0.03% = ~6 NIFTY points or ~13 BANKNIFTY points in one 5s bar — meaningful only when paired with a large volume spike. Replaces original's 0.2% on 1-min bars; the threshold is lower because 0.2% in 5 seconds would be an extreme 40+ point NIFTY move requiring news-level events.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumulative(typical_price * volume) / cumulative(volume) from session open
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP unchanged from original. Acts as institutional benchmark: a volume spike closing above VWAP signals buy-side institutional demand outpacing supply; below VWAP signals institutional selling. Cumulative measures don't need lookback scaling.

conditions: bar_return_pct > 0.03 (green bar with meaningful price impact)
close > vwap (institutional buy-side conviction above benchmark)
buy_ce.confirmation: No additional bar wait — enter on next bar after the spike bar closes. At 5s resolution, waiting 2 bars like the original (= 10 seconds) risks missing the follow-through window.

conditions: bar_return_pct < -0.03 (red bar with meaningful price impact)
close < vwap (institutional sell-side pressure below benchmark)
buy_pe.confirmation: Enter on next bar after spike bar closes.

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts = ~8 NIFTY spot points. If genuine institutional momentum is driving the move, the index should not retrace 8 spot points within 30-60 seconds — that magnitude of reversal implies the spike was absorbed by opposing institutional flow or was a false print. At delta ~0.5, 8 spot pts maps to ~4 option pts.
exit.target_rationale: 6 option pts = ~12 NIFTY spot points. Institutional momentum follow-through on NIFTY typically extends 10-20 spot points within the 15-60 second window (per 30s typical move of 2-5 option pts). Targeting 6 pts captures the lower-end continuation (1:1.5 R:R) and covers costs with margin at typical 7-lot sizing.

filters.vix_filter: none — institutional flows occur regardless of VIX level; volume spike itself is the noise filter
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:20 IST; skip first 5 min (09:15-09:20) for opening auction distortion
filters.trend_filter: VWAP direction confirms the spike direction
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — volume spike thresholds may need re-tuning as NIFTY lot size changes or market microstructure evolves; FII flow seasonality affects frequency

adaptation_notes: Three key changes from original: (1) Universe changed from NIFTY100 stock basket to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index directly — removes need for institutional_ownership filter, block_deal data, and spread filter; (2) Volume SMA lookback compressed from 20 1-min bars (20 min) to 120 5s bars (10 min) to stay responsive to intraday regime shifts; (3) Entry moved from 2-bar wait (2 min in original) to immediate next bar — at 5s resolution any wait risks the follow-through window closing. Bar return threshold reduced from 0.2% to 0.03% to be meaningful on 5-second bars. Hold time compressed from 10-30 min to 15-60 seconds.
weaknesses: NIFTY/BANKNIFTY volume data from index proxies can be noisy — futures volume is cleaner but may not always be available
Opening 5 minutes excluded but remaining early session still has elevated vol_spike false positives
4x volume threshold may generate very few signals on low-volume days
At 5-second resolution, bar_return of 0.03% requires genuine price movement — very low VIX days have smaller moves and may filter out signals
